subject: economics
objective: How responsive is quantity to a price change?
instruction: A shop in Northport records: At a price of USD 10 the quantity demanded is 100 units; after the price changes to USD 12 the quantity demanded is 80 units. Use the midpoint (arc) method: percentage change = change / average of the two values. Price elasticity of demand = percentage change in quantity / percentage change in price, reported as a positive number (absolute value). Revenue = price x quantity. Point elasticity from the start = (change in Q / Q1) / (change in P / P1). Required: percentage change quantity, percentage change price, price elasticity of demand, revenue 1, revenue 2, revenue change.
